characterization_methods: time of flight secondary-ion mass spectroscopy (TOF-SIMS)
evidence: Thicknesses (typically 5–15 nm) were measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry. Time of flight secondary-ion mass spectroscopy (TOF-SIMS) depth profiles were obtained using a dual ion beam setup with a 500 eV Xe+ ion beam, followed by 15 keV Ga+. The Hf content was measured by Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy (RBS) in a Charles Evans & Associates RBS400 end station with a 1 MeV He+ beam in a rotating random mode.
